records.context: Runs the steps of this module in order. Divisions are read with :func:`division_events`; ``mode='auto'`` keeps whichever kind, fission or budding, the movie has more of. Each division is checked (parent seen at ``t_div`` and on 80% of the window, daughters seen on the next frame, two daughters for a fission). The kept divisions get size-matched controls (:func:`match_controls`) and a shuffled alignment (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) with its own size-matched controls, so the null runs the same matching at a random time. The late-vs-baseline change of every unit (:func:`unit_changes`) is compared as Hedges' g (:func:`effect_size`), dividing against control and shuffled against its control. Complete fission cycles give the size-control fits.

records.translation: Svipgerðarsjónsvið við 20X er ekki jafnt lýst: á plötu A hjá Funk et al. 2022 fá hornin um helming ljóssins sem miðjan fær. Fruma sem er mæld í horni sýnist þá daufari en sama fruma í miðjunni, og í samsafnaðri skimun, þar sem frumur hvers leiðara sitja á slembistöðum, bætir það suði við hvern styrkeiginleika og skekkir frumurnar nálægt jaðrinum.

records.context: THE MAP. Per laboratory microplate and channel, a few hundred microscope fields of view are read, block-averaged in 16 x 16 pixel blocks, and the per-block median over the microscope fields of view is taken. Cells move from microscope field of view to microscope field of view while the illumination does not, so the median keeps the illumination and loses the cells. It is smoothed with a Gaussian (sigma 6 blocks, about 96 microscope field of view pixels); the nuclear channel, whose sparse bright nuclei leave a noisier median, is then fitted with a 4th-order 2-D polynomial. The camera and background offset ``b`` is the 0.1th percentile of every block mean, and the map is ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 at the centre. It is floored at 0.25, so no pixel is multiplied by more than 4.
records.label: spacr.ops_flatfield#2
records.source: THE MAP. Per plate and channel, a few hundred fields are read, block-averaged in 16 x 16 pixel blocks, and the per-block median over the fields is taken. Cells move from field to field while the illumination does not, so the median keeps the illumination and loses the cells. It is smoothed with a Gaussian (sigma 6 blocks, about 96 field pixels); the nuclear channel, whose sparse bright nuclei leave a noisier median, is then fitted with a 4th-order 2-D polynomial. The camera and background offset ``b`` is the 0.1th percentile of every block mean, and the map is ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 at the centre. It is floored at 0.25, so no pixel is multiplied by more than 4.
records.translation: KORTIÐ. Fyrir hverja plötu og rás eru nokkur hundruð sjónsvið lesin, meðaltöl tekin í 16 x 16 pixla blokkum og miðgildi hverrar blokkar yfir sjónsviðin tekið. Frumur færast milli sjónsviða en lýsingin ekki, svo miðgildið heldur lýsingunni og tapar frumunum. Það er jafnað með Gauss-síu (sigma 6 blokkir, um 96 pixlar sjónsviðs); kjarnarásin, þar sem strjálir bjartir kjarnar skilja eftir suðmeira miðgildi, er síðan aðlöguð með tvívíðri margliðu af stigi 4. Hliðrun myndavélar og bakgrunns ``b`` er 0.1 hundraðshlutamark allra blokkameðaltala, og kortið er ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 í miðjunni. Lággildi þess er 0.25, svo enginn pixill er margfaldaður með meira en 4.

records.context: Core ownership by the sequencing centroid (A1b). A nucleus imaged in two overlapping phenotype microscope fields of view is kept from the microscope field of view in which its sequencing centroid lies deepest, not from the closer match (:func:`deduplicate_matches`). The closer match is often the margin copy, and a margin copy is more often cut by the microscope field of view's edge: on laboratory microplate A of Funk et al. 2022 the closer match kept a different copy for 14.4 percent of linked cells. Equal depths go to the closer match, then to the first row.
records.label: spacr.ops_merge.deepest_field_matches#6
records.source: CORE OWNERSHIP BY THE SEQUENCING CENTROID (A1b). A nucleus imaged in two overlapping phenotype fields is kept from the field in which its sequencing centroid lies deepest, not from the closer match (:func:`deduplicate_matches`). The closer match is often the margin copy, and a margin copy is more often cut by the field's edge: on plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the closer match kept a different copy for 14.4 percent of linked cells. Equal depths go to the closer match, then to the first row.
records.translation: MIÐJUEIGNARHALD EFTIR MASSAMIÐJU RAÐGREININGAR (A1b). Kjarni sem er myndaður í tveimur skarast svipgerðarsjónsviðum er tekinn úr því sjónsviði þar sem raðgreiningarmassamiðja hans liggur dýpst, ekki úr nánari samsvöruninni (:func:`deduplicate_matches`). Nánari samsvörunin er oft jaðareintakið, og jaðareintak er oftar skorið af jaðri sjónsviðsins: á plötu A hjá Funk et al. 2022 hélt nánari samsvörunin öðru eintaki fyrir 14.4 prósent tengdra fruma. Jöfn dýpt fer til nánari samsvörunarinnar, síðan til fyrstu raðar.

records.context: The Make Masks timelapse run writes one results folder per tracked field under ``tracks/division/`` when ``timelapse_division_analysis`` is on (see :func:`spacr.division_analysis.write_division_results`).
